assign.outcome:
**Selects: full width stays the default, the chevron is fixed at the base, and `select.auto` is the one-word opt-out.** The arrow now sits `right 0.5em center` from the padding box - an edge offset, not `100%` + content-box origin, which pinned it to where the text ends and walked it onto every shrink-to-fit select. Base also reserves the arrow's lane (`padding-inline-end: 1.4em`). Five chrome selects swept to the utility, their local width/origin patches deleted: [generator](/framework/core/Page/generator/) menus, [demo](/framework/ext/demo/) zoom, ext/layout pick, [AI board](/framework/ai/) compose, DesignTool vision filters.
